tagline: Hosted Streamable HTTP memory for AI agents with per-user Bearer keys, secret masking, and optional AES-256-GCM Arweave anchoring.
summary: Hosted Streamable HTTP memory at https://aifa.works/api/mcp for Claude, Cursor, VS Code, and other MCP clients. Per upstream HOSTED-POLICY.md, discovery (initialize, tools/list) is public and tools/call uses a per-user Bearer key (memory-only keys supported). Read-only info tools keep Guard's usual handling; private memory, exports, billing, payouts, and webhooks stay on review.
limitations: Coverage is limited to the reviewed operations and the surrounding Guard policy.
Per upstream HOSTED-POLICY.md, all tools/call invocations (including memory_about, plans, and partner_kit) require a per-user Bearer key from https://aifa.works/mcp.

The hosted backend at aifa.works is closed source; upstream policy and live verification script are published at https://github.com/MaksimGalatin/aifa-memory-mcp (HOSTED-POLICY.md and scripts/conformance.py).
A maintainer profile is not a security certification or an official upstream endorsement.
